confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from one web search. Its main source was Numbeo's crowdsourced Marmaris listing (rewritten Oct 2026), which gave lira prices: cappuccino about TRY 177, domestic draft beer about TRY 150, inexpensive meal about TRY 500 and mid-range meal for two about TRY 2,150. I converted these to USD at an assumed rate of roughly 44-46 TRY per USD, based on my general knowledge of the lira's continuing depreciation, not on a searched rate. The lira is volatile, and other sources quoted lower USD prices for coffee and beer (about $2-3), so drink anchors carry moderate uncertainty. I did not search for cocktail or wine prices. Both are estimated from the local relationship to beer and typical tourist-resort bar pricing, where alcohol is heavily taxed in Turkey. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for peak July season in a busy package-resort town with few registered hostels. Hostel figures are especially uncertain, and I did not consult any booking data.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink are based on Marmaris crowdsourced price data. Accommodation is benchmarked against other Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resort towns such as Fethiye, Bodrum (lower tier) and Kusadasi in July high season.
